const MODES = ['uppercase', 'lowercase', 'slug'];

function slugify(text, trim) {
  let s = text.toLowerCase();
  if (trim) s = s.trim();
  s = s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
  s = s.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  return s;
}

function transform({ text, mode, trim }) {
  if (mode === 'slug') return slugify(text, trim);
  let s = text;
  if (trim) s = s.trim();
  if (mode === 'uppercase') return s.toUpperCase();
  if (mode === 'lowercase') return s.toLowerCase();
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'text_transform',
      description: 'Transform text by case or slug.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          text: { type: 'string', description: 'The text to transform.' },
          mode: { type: 'string', enum: MODES, description: 'Transform mode.' },
          trim: { type: 'boolean', default: true, description: 'Trim whitespace before transforming.' }
        },
        required: ['text', 'mode'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'text_transform') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  const { text, mode, trim = true, ...extra } = args;
  const errors = [];
  if (typeof text !== 'string') errors.push('text is required and must be a string');

  const result = transform({ text, mode, trim });
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text: result }] };
}
